New York's Diamond District: Botswana wants a 0% US tariff line to sell finished jewellery straight into America.

Minerals minister Bogolo Joy Kenewendo named the rate at Climate Week NYC, telling Rapaport News on 27 September manufacturers already export to the US. No export volume, value or tariff schedule was published alongside the remarks.

New York jewelers, take note: a Glendale, California store lost more than $1 million after a radio jammer kept its alarm online but silent.

The Jewelers' Security Alliance counted violence in 27.1% of 2025 jewelry crimes, up from 16.9%, JCK reports. A detector exists — DMP's Jam Alert, launched June 2025 — for a few hundred dollars.
